 Tech Salesforce to acquire Braze in a $5.66 billion deal
 Published Tue, Oct 20 2026 8:25 AM EDT WATCH LIVE In this article
 CRM 
 BRZE 
 Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT Piotr Swat | Lightrocket | Getty Images Salesforce said on Tuesday it would acquire customer engagement platform Braze for about $5.66 billion.
 The customer relationship management platform's shares fell 2.6% in premarket trading.
 Braze Class A shareholders will receive $47.50 in cash per share, under the terms of the agreement.
 The deal is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal year 2028, subject to approval by Braze shareholders and regulators.
